record.question: Do I not greet my friends warmly? Select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive Voice:
options: Are my friends not greeted warmly by me?
Were my friends not warmly greeted by me?
Will my friends not be warmly greeted by me?
Have my friends not been warmly greeted by me?
record.explanation: The original is a negative present simple question. The passive therefore uses are + greeted, preserving the question, negation, and agent: Are my friends not greeted warmly by me? Reviewed solution (unofficial). References: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/active-passive-voice
